name: SumatraPDF
description: SumatraPDF reads release metadata from its HTTPS update-check URL and selects installer or portable URLs by architecture; the reviewed flow does not show hash or Authenticode validation before offering the retrieved installer.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot; not historical release re-verification.
External updater-library behavior and released artifact signing/notarization remain outside the cited source unless directly shown.
